name: DCWP Language Line Interpretation Services
description: This dataset records uses of a language line interpretation service, with one row per interpreted call or session. Each record includes the date of the interaction, the language interpreted, an access code identifying the requesting agency or service channel, and the call duration in seconds. With 5,000 sampled rows and four columns, it provides a compact view of demand for interpretation across languages and over time. It can be used to analyze which languages are most frequently requested, compare call volumes and average call lengths by language or access code, identify peak periods, and support staffing or budgeting decisions for interpretation services.
